text:
jordan-acme: Hey team — forwarding the customer's security questionnaire. They want evidence for log retention policies, proof of customer key custody (KMS), and answers on RBAC change history. Need packet by EOD Friday.

alex: Got it. We can assemble. Quick clarifying q's: 1) retention windows: do they want per-log-type (admin/audit/app) or a single policy? 2) For key custody, do they want a signed attestation or screenshots of IAM/KMS policies?

sara: For retention we have separate policies: audit logs = 7 years (default for enterprise), app logs = 90 days, metrics = 365 days aggregated. I can paste the policy snippet.

sara: ```
# log-retention.yaml
audit_log_retention: "7y"
application_log_retention: "90d"
metrics_retention_days: "365"
export_policy:
  - destination: "s3://redwood-enterprise-logs/<customer>"
  - encryption: "kms" 
```

alex: Perfect. For the packet let's include that YAML, an excerpt of the Console UI showing the retention page, and the export audit S3 bucket policy.

mike: Regarding KMS custody: for Private deployments we support customer-managed keys in their KMS (bring-your-own-key). For Hosted, we offer envelope encryption with customer-managed keys through our key-encryption-key flow (we never persist plaintext key material). I can export the API calls that show the key policy binding to the customer's principal.

mike: Example AWS call we can include: ```
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <key-id> --policy-name default
```

audrey: Also include the key rotation schedule and proof of rotation events for the last 90 days. We should redact any account numbers in screenshots, but keep ARNs for traceability.

alex: Good call. Jordan — do they accept exported rotation audit events or do they require HSM attestation (e.g., AWS CloudHSM attestation)?

jordan-acme: They prefer attestation if available, otherwise signed logs + KMS policy + rotation events are acceptable. They also want evidence that RBAC changes are audited (who changed role bindings and when).

sara: We have an RBAC change log in our internal audit DB. I can pull a sample CSV with columns: timestamp, operator, action, resource, change_id. Example row: `2026-02-18T15:12:03Z,alex,grant,role/dedicated-admin,chg-9a7c`. We'll include a sanitized sample + query used.

sara: Query to run: ```sql
SELECT ts, actor, action, resource, change_id FROM rbac_audit WHERE customer_id = 'acme' AND ts > '2025-01-01' LIMIT 100;
```

mike: On vuln triage — the questionnaire had a checkbox about recent CVEs. We remediated CVE-2026-1423 in the runtime last month. Patch notes + CVE reference will be included. Mitigation: kernel bump + runtime config toggle (disable-legacy-ciphers).

mike: Patch evidence: commit hash `f3a2b9d`, deploy job id `deploy-20260114-77`, and SRE post-deploy checks.

alex: For the security review call that follows the packet, let's propose Wednesday 10am PDT. jordan-acme — does that work? We'll have infra + legal on the call.

jordan-acme: Wed 10am PDT works. Please share a calendar invite and the evidence zip beforehand.

audrey: Also flag: data minimization question. We should include the log-sampling rules to show we redact PII from app logs before export. Example rule: `redact_patterns: [email, ssn]` and a short note on hashing/pepper for identifiers.

sec-bot: Uploaded sanitized evidence draft to internal share: https://internal.redwood/safe/evidence/acme-draft-1935012345 (access: eng-security, infra, legal).

alex: I'll assemble the packet: YAML snippets, KMS policy dumps, RBAC CSV sample, vuln patch references, log redaction rules, and a short one-page summary. Will upload final ZIP to Zendesk ticket #45721 and share link here.

mike: I'll export rotation events and KMS policy JSONs by EOD.

sara: I'll run the RBAC query and sanitize.

audrey: I'll draft the one-page privacy/retention statement.

jordan-acme: Thanks — customer wants ability to verify the signed rotation events. If HSM attestation isn't possible for hosted, they'll accept signed audit logs with a sha256 checksum.

alex: Noted. We'll include SHA256 checksums for exported files and a verification guide.

alex: Last note — if we need formal AICPA/ISO artifacts, escalate to GRC. For now this packet should cover the questionnaire and prep for the call.

alex: Uploading final packet to Zendesk and calendar invite scheduled. Follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
